item.title: Schools Benefit from Radio-to-Intercom Bridge
item.description: How are schools ideally suited to Quickly benefit from the Radio-To-Intercom Bridge? The Radio-To-Intercom Bridge™ connects two systems commonly found in schools – the PA system and the two-way radio network. It enables two-way radios to access and communicate to the entire school over the PA system. So here is why this device is ideally suited […]
